metadata.short_desc: Uses an independent LLM to stop only naturally completed exchanges.
metadata.desc: Silently stops the default reply only for a high-confidence closed exchange. Uncertain and failed judgements always fail open.

enabled.hint: When disabled, no history is stored, no judge is called, and no messages are intercepted.

judge_provider_id.hint: Choose an existing AstrBot chat provider. Missing or unavailable providers fail open.

confidence_threshold.hint: This is not a random reply probability.
